item.title: Hendra By-Law Revoked
item.description: Update 2 February 2015 Equestrian Australia (EA) has today revoked the EA Hendra Vaccination By-Law effective immediately. The panel (commissioned by the EA Board) will remain in place to complete a full assessment on the risk that the Hendra virus creates for EA events nationally.

item.title: Alison Rowland on Yalambi’s Carpino Z wins CSI2*-W Sydney during the Royal Easter Show
item.description: For the first time, the Grand Prix at the Sydney Royal was rated as a FEI World Cup 2 star event. A first in Sydney that could not be overlooked! The Sydney Easter Show in Olympic Park was a perfect backdrop to gather families and insiders to enjoy the sport in the main arena. The event was originally scheduled for Tuesday afternoon however was postponed to Wednesday morning due to weather. This delay enabled the grass footing to dry which provided perfect conditions for the horses and riders.

item.title: Chris Burton wins British Open
item.description: Australia’s own Chris Burton has won the British Eventing Open over the weekend. Riding TS Jamaimo, Burton rose steadily through the ranks from ninth place after showjumping as a dramatic competition unfolded in the Festival’s showpiece class. New Zealander Jonelle Price, was second on Classic Moet, and Nicola Wilson from North Yorkshire finished third on Beltane Queen.

item.title: Australian Reining Team Named for 2018 FEI World Equestrian Games
item.description: Equestrian Australia (EA) is pleased to announce the Australian Reining Team for the 2018 FEI World Equestrian Games in Tryon, USA, this September. Congratulations to the following riders; Dan James Martin Larcombe Robyn Schiller Shauna Larcombe Warwick Schiller

item.title: Chris Burton Wins ERM Series
item.description: Chris Burton won the final leg of the 2018 Event Rider Masters today (Sunday, 26 August) at the Land Rover Blair Castle International Horse Trials and so confirmed himself as winner of the series. In total, he won £46,000 — £16,000 for the leg victory and £30,000 for the series. The Australian put in the only round inside the time across country in pouring rain to move up from fourth after showjumping, riding the syndicate-owned Graf Liberty.

item.title: REMINDER: FEI MERs Change Effective July 1, 2021
item.description: The FEI have confirmed that you must meet the new FEI MER criteria to be able to compete, even if you were previously qualified at that level. This could affect you and your plans for competition from July 1, 2021. Riders are strongly encouraged to read the MERs effective 1 July 2021 to ensure they are qualified to compete at any level on or after 1 July 2021.

item.title: Calling for 2021-2023 National Discipline Committee EOIs (Jumping and Endurance)
item.description: Equestrian Australia is calling for National Discipline Committee (NDC) Expressions of Interest for casual vacancies as listed below. All of the below positions will be for a three (3) year term (unless current committee members are re-standing for their 5th & 6th consecutive years, in which case appointment will be for 2 years from 1 January 2021) as of 1 January 2021 until 31st December 2023.
